mapper.select: SELECT * FROM PRODUCT_TBL P INNER JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON P.STORE_ID = S.STORE_ID WHERE PRO_NO = #{proNo}

SELECT c.CART_ID, p.PRO_NAME, P.PRICE AS DEF_PRICE, po.OPTION_NAME AS TOP_OPT, pso.VALUE_NAME AS SUB_OPT, co.CART_OPT_QUANTITY AS OPT_QTT, NVL(pso.PRICE_DIFF, 0) AS SUB_OPT_PRICE FROM CART_TBL c JOIN PRODUCT_TBL p ON c.PRO_NO = p.PRO_NO JOIN CART_OPTION_TBL co ON c.CART_ID = co.CART_ID JOIN PRODUCT_SUB_OPTION_TBL pso ON co.SUB_OPTION_ID = pso.SUB_OPTION_ID JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_TBL po ON pso.TOP_OPTION_ID = po.TOP_OPTION_ID WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART_TBL VALUES(SEQ_CART_ID.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{proNo}, #{storeId}, #{cartQuantity}, #{totalPrice}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{letteringText})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM REVIEW_TBL R LEFT JOIN USER_TBL U ON R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE PRO_NO = #{proNo}

SELECT Q.QUESTION_ID, Q.PRO_NO, Q.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME AS userName, Q.QUESTION_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(Q.QUESTION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS QUESTION_DATE, Q.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, Q.ANSWER_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(Q.ANSWER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ANSWER_DATE FROM QA_TBL Q LEFT JOIN USER_TBL U ON Q.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON Q.STORE_ID = S.STORE_ID WHERE 1=1
AND (Q.QUESTION_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{qnaKeyword} || '%' OR U.USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{qnaKeyword} || '%')
AND Q.QUESTION_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{qnaKeyword} || '%'
AND U.USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{qnaKeyword} || '%'
AND Q.USER_ID = #{userId}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN Q.ANSWER_CONTENT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, Q.QUESTION_DATE DESC
OFFSET #{page} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM QA_TBL WHERE 1=1
